integrity: The correction follows from direct expansion of the squared-modulus identity from the source characteristic equation. The bundled verifier independently checks the identity and numerical witness.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the printed second-delay crossing reduction only; it does not recompute the complete stability diagram or nonlinear Hopf dynamics.
No claim is made that the plotted crossing curve was generated from the erroneous printed formulas.
The numerical witness uses coefficients rounded to four decimals; the symbolic correction is exact.
title: Correcting the second-delay crossing reduction in an age-structured predator-prey model
